releaseNotes:
## Guest Inbox
- Availability reply can include an editable booking-request form so guests fill it in and reply
- Form uses the same labels Import details already reads
- Empty form setting falls back to the built-in standard form

## Settings
- Reply snippets are visible again under Connections -> Email (no longer collapsed)
- Edit availability reply, unavailable reply, and booking-request form in one place
- Availability template supports `{bookingForm}`; if missing, the form is added when you use "We have availability"
- Saving mail settings still does not send mail
